integrity: The equality-case proof is analytic. A standalone exact exponent checker verifies the finite root-of-unity parametrization; numerical sampling is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the fixed support \(\{0,1,2,3\}\subset\mathbb Z_5\); no classification is asserted for other supports. The 1981 support-level result is prior work and is not re-claimed.
title: Complete extremizer classification for the four-character extreme set in \(\mathbb Z_5\)
